question: A shopkeeper buys three products a, b, c and sells at 20%, 30%, 40% profit, respectively. What is ratio of the selling price of these products, if the ratio of their cost prices is 4 ∶ 3 ∶ 2?
solution:
Given:

A shopkeeper buys three products a, b, c and sells at 20%, 30%, 40% profit, respectively.

The ratio of their cost prices is 4 ∶ 3 ∶ 2.

Concept used:

Selling Price = Cost Price × (1 + Profit%)

Calculation:

Now, the ratio of the selling price of these products

⇒ 4(1 + 20%) : 3(1 + 30%) : 2(1 + 40%)

⇒ 4 × 1.2 : 3 × 1.3 : 2 × 1.4

⇒ 4.8: 3.9 : 2.8

⇒ 48 ∶ 39 ∶ 28

**∴ The ratio of the selling price of these products is 48 ∶ 39 ∶ 28.**
